title: Lost Mary BM6000 Watermelon Kiwi Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Watermelon Kiwi combines two distinct fruit profiles for a refreshing and well-rounded vape. The blend leads with the mellow, juicy hydration of Watermelon, offering a light and sweet foundation. This is intersected by the sharper, exotic tang of Kiwi, which adds a layer of brightness and zest, ensuring the flavour remains crisp and engaging throughout. Designed for use with the Lost Mary BM6000 V2 Prefilled Pod Kit , this pack includes a replaceable 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, allowing you to refresh your device with ease. This system extends the lifespan of your device, providing up to 6000 puffs while offering the flexibility to switch flavours at any time. How To Setup Lost Mary BM6000 Pod & Refill Step 1 Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. Step 2 Remove any safety stickers from the components. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the device. Step 4 Attach the refill container to the side of the device. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. Step 6 Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set! When the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them with a new set to continue enjoying your Lost Mary BM6000 V2 device.
